new.subject: Welcome to AgriColtivio – your Membership is active
new.welcome: Welcome to AgriColtivio, the association behind Coltivio. Good to have you with us.
new.carried_by_members: Coltivio is funded by member contributions and donations. No investor expecting a return, and nobody making a business out of your data. You are supporting open and fair agriculture in Switzerland.
benefits: A vote at the general meeting: you help decide where Coltivio goes
Personal support with questions about the app, your farm or the next inspection
Access to the meeting point, where you exchange with other farmers
Insight into the finances: the annual report and accounts go to the members every year

first_payment.subject: Your Membership has been charged
first_payment.intro: Your Membership has been successfully charged. Thank you for being part of AgriColtivio!

renewal.subject: Your Coltivio Membership has been renewed
renewal.intro: Great to have you still with us! Your Membership has been successfully renewed — you continue to have full access to all Coltivio features.

reactivation.subject: Welcome back to Coltivio
reactivation.intro: Great to have you back. Your Membership is active again — you have full access to all features until {{date}}.

expiry_reminder.subject: Your Coltivio membership has expired
expiry_reminder.intro: Your membership expired on {{date}}. You still have 10 days of access to all Coltivio features — please renew your membership to keep full access.

payment_failed.subject: Payment failed – please update your payment method
payment_failed.intro: The automatic renewal of your Coltivio membership has failed. You still have 10 days of access — please update your payment method to avoid an interruption.

access_lost.subject: Your Coltivio access has been suspended
access_lost.intro: Your Coltivio membership has expired and your access to the app features has been temporarily suspended. You can still renew your membership within 20 days to restore full access.

membership_ended.subject: Your Coltivio membership has ended
membership_ended.intro: Your membership with AgriColtivio has now ended. We sincerely thank you for the time you were part of our community — it was a pleasure to accompany you and your farm. Your data is preserved and you can return at any time.

cancellation.subject: Your Coltivio membership has been cancelled
cancellation.intro: We have received your cancellation. Your resignation takes effect immediately. You've already paid through {{date}} — you can withdraw your resignation until then.
cancellation.reactivate_hint: If you change your mind, you can withdraw your resignation in the app.

donation_email.intro: Thank you for your donation! You are supporting open and fair agriculture in Switzerland.
donation_email.subtitle: from AgriColtivio

verification_email.subject: Confirm your email address
verification_email.subtitle: from AgriColtivio
verification_email.intro: Good to have you on board. Please confirm your email address so we can reach you with questions about your farm and so you can reset your password if you ever forget it.
verification_email.expiry_note: The link is valid for 14 days.
verification_email.ignore_note: If you did not sign up for Coltivio, you can ignore this email.

welcome_email.subject: Welcome to Coltivio
welcome_email.subtitle: from AgriColtivio
welcome_email.intro: Your email address is confirmed. Coltivio is now fully open to you: fields and field calendar, livestock and treatment journal, tasks and your wiki, all recorded out on the farm instead of at the computer in the evening.
welcome_email.verein_title: An association stands behind the app
welcome_email.verein_body: Coltivio is developed and run by the association AgriColtivio, a non-profit association under Swiss law based in Braggio in the Calanca valley. The association is politically independent and pursues no commercial interests of its own. Coltivio is funded by member contributions and donations. No investor expecting a return, and nobody making a business out of your data.
welcome_email.open_source: The source code is open, and your data is stored on servers in the EU.
welcome_email.membership_body: As a member you have a say at the general meeting on where the software goes. You reach us directly with questions about the app, your farm or the next inspection, and the meeting point in the web app is open to you, where you exchange with other farmers.
welcome_email.contact: If you have questions, reach us at
